body.statement: For every fixed \(B\ge1\), every fixed \(0<c\le1\), and every integer sequence \(1\le d_n\le n\), \[K_n(d_n;B,c)\longrightarrow0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad d_n=o(n^{2/3}).\] No additional slowly varying boundary factor is present.
body.justification: This candidate iff statement is the field-tier target, contingent on D0 verification of both the martingale upper bound and the repeated-star limit.
body.gap: No cited paper gives a necessary-and-sufficient degree condition for the fixed \(r=2\) CGD estimator; \cite{KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024CGD} gives only \(1/9\) sufficiency and a nonsharp obstruction.
body.consumer: A verified frontier would supply a single asymptotic design rule for deciding when CGD normal inference is uniformly justified.
